title: Introduction to JavaScript
description: Learn the fundamentals of JavaScript programming, including variables, functions, loops, arrays, and objects.

title: Frontend Development with React
description: Build interactive user interfaces using React components, props, state, hooks, and modern frontend development practices.

title: Backend Development with Node.js
description: Develop backend applications and REST APIs using Node.js, Express, routing, middleware, and asynchronous JavaScript.

title: Python for Data Analysis
description: Learn how to analyse datasets, manipulate data, and extract insights using Python and popular data analysis libraries.

title: SQL and Database Management
description: Learn how to design relational databases, write SQL queries, retrieve data, and manage database relationships.

title: Cloud Computing with AWS
description: Explore cloud computing fundamentals and deploy applications using AWS services, including EC2, S3, IAM, and Lambda.

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Understand common security threats, network security, authentication, encryption, and defensive security practices.

title: DevOps and CI/CD
description: Learn how to automate software delivery using Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, and infrastructure automation fundamentals.
